context: Evaluates whether the model correctly uses EventsEmit to emit named events with optional variadic data arguments. The key challenge is knowing that EventsEmit must receive the event name as its first argument and that all subsequent arguments are data payloads passed through to listeners.

checklist.name: EventsEmit used
checklist.description: EventsEmit from @wailsapp/runtime is called when broadcast is invoked

checklist.name: Event name as first arg
checklist.description: The eventName string is passed as the first argument to EventsEmit

checklist.name: Data args forwarded
checklist.description: All variadic data arguments supplied to broadcast are forwarded to EventsEmit after the event name (zero or more)

checklist.name: No extra arguments
checklist.description: No extra or hardcoded arguments are injected between eventName and the caller-supplied data
